s.Performance terrain + ajustement linéair: On-pitch performance + linear adjustment for club level + age adjustment (V8 formula). Favours players at big clubs.
s.Performance projetée au niveau d'un club: Performance projected to the level of an average JPL club, without age: what the player is worth today.
s.Le Score privé de son seul ajustement d': The Score without its age adjustment only: same performance, same club-level adjustment, but a 31-year-old is no longer penalised for his age. The reading to use when looking for an experienced profile.
s.100 % = réglage d'origine. 0 % = l'âge n: 100% = original setting. 0% = age no longer counts in the Score. 200% = a young player gets twice the bonus, an older player twice the penalty.
s.100 % = réglage d'origine. 0 % = le nive: 100% = original setting. 0% = the level of the club and its league no longer counts: the Score moves towards pure performance. 200% = the gap between big and small clubs is doubled.
s.**Score** : performance sur la période +: **Score**: performance over the period + club level + age (season score formula). **Performance**: on-pitch performance only.
s.Ne garde que les joueurs qui corresponde: Keeps only players who match this sub-archetype, sorted by match.
s.Ne garde que les joueurs dont la corresp: Keeps only players whose match to this profile is above this threshold.
s.Cherche dans TOUS les postes. Les résult: Searches ALL positions. Results appear just below: one click opens the player card and switches the ranking to the right position.
s.⚠️ Ce nom sort sur plusieurs postes : ch: ⚠️ This name appears at several positions: pick the line you want.
s.1 = première division. Vide = tous, y co: 1 = top division. Empty = all, including those not filled in.
s.« exclus » est réservé à la liste des jo: “exclus” is reserved for the list of excluded players.
s.⚠️ Listes **non durables** : elles seron: ⚠️ Lists are **not durable**: they will be wiped at the next publication or restart. Add the `[listes]` section in Settings → Secrets.
s.Clique une première date puis une second: Click a first date then a second: only players whose contract ends between the two remain. Empty = no filter. To clear it, use the cross on the right of the field.
s.Choisis la seconde date pour activer le: Pick the second date to activate the filter.
s.Garder aussi les joueurs sans date: Also keep players with no date
s.Impect ne donne pas de date de fin pour: Impect gives no end date for about 8% of players. Unticked, they leave the list as soon as a range is chosen.
s.Retire les joueurs dont la date de fin d: Removes players whose contract end date has already passed (Impect record out of date, or free agent). Players with no date at all stay in the list.
s.Filtre de style, descriptif : il ne modi: Style filter, descriptive: it changes neither the score nor the ranking. Percentiles computed by position across about a hundred leagues.
s.**Niveau** = score de performance du pos: **Level** = performance score for the position: 50 = median player, ~67 = top 10%, already corrected for the difficulty of each match.

s.Les courbes ne sont pas reliées d'une sa: Curves are not connected from one season to another.

s.règle dérivée des autres profils du post: rule derived from the other profiles of the position
s.Défenseur couvreur (06) non calculé : vi: Covering centre-back (06) not computed: speed, anticipation and running 1v1 are not measured by Impect.
s.Correspondance = ressemblance de style (: Match = style resemblance (0-100), not a level: level remains the score. Watch-out = point of attention on a non-negotiable of the profile; the style info (touch zones, backward play, play under pressure) is descriptive and does not count in the score.
s.Pression adverse moyenne (0-100) au mome: Average opponent pressure (0-100) at the moment he releases the ball. Mostly describes his role and playing zone.
s.Part de ses passes sous forte pression (: Share of his passes under high pressure (≥ 50) that gain ground towards goal. This is boldness: under pressure, the league average drops to 23%.
s.Cette part rapportée à la même part sans: That share relative to the same share without pressure. 1.00 = he plays the same pressed or free; 0.69 is the league median.
s.Passes réussies au-dessus de l'attendu,: Completed passes above expected, per 100 passes under high pressure, for comparable position, zone and distance.
s.Packing : adversaires entre le ballon et: Packing: opponents between the ball and the goal that he takes out with his passes, above expected.
s.Volume brut, très dépendant du volume de: Raw volume, highly dependent on the team's volume of play.
s.Passes réussies qui font entrer le ballo: Completed passes that take the ball into the opponent's box.
s.Pas de mesure à ce poste : le jeu sous p: No measure at this position: play under pressure is shown from 80 passes played at this position, and its progression part from 400 minutes and 20 passes under high pressure. Some leagues are not covered by the study.
s.Ces indicateurs sont **descriptifs : ils: These indicators are **descriptive: they enter no score**. Measured on 5,056 players followed from one season to the next, they add only 0.4 point of R² to predict the following season, when the score explains 15.5.
s.Au-dessus de 0,60 la mesure décrit le jo: Above 0.60 the measure describes the player; below, it mostly describes his team and his volume of play.
s.sens de l'attaque ⟶ · plus foncé =: direction of attack  ⟶   ·   darker = more actions
s.Pas de carte pour cette fiche : champion: No map for this card: league outside the event collection (youth leagues, seasons before 2025) or fewer than 80 actions at this position.
s.Pas de carte sur cette période : les évé: No map over this period: the events of his matches are not collected yet, or his league is outside the collection.
s.Ajoute les touches, corners, coups franc: Adds the throw-ins, corners, free kicks and goal kicks he takes. Unticked by default: they draw the taker's corner flag and touchline more than his play.
s.**Championnat en cours de téléchargement: **League being downloaded.** Only his passes and receptions are available for now: the map below shows only those, whatever the button. Shots, ball carries, set pieces and defensive actions will arrive together once all the league's matches are retrieved.
s.Aucune action de ce type enregistrée à c: No action of this type recorded at this position.
s.Chaque action est placée à ses coordonné: Each action is placed at its real coordinates (Impect events, 2.5 m cells), for this position only. The top of the map is the player's left side. The table gives the share of actions by lane and by Impect third. Descriptive: outside the score.
s.Comparaison impossible : les piliers de: Comparison impossible: this player's pillars are not measured.
s.100 = identique. 50 = aussi proches que: 100 = identical. 50 = as close as two players at the position picked at random. Already pulled towards 50 when the comparison is unreliable.
s.**Similarité** : 100 = identique, 50 = a: **Similarity**: 100 = identical, 50 = as close as two players at the position picked at random. It says two players resemble each other, not that one is worth the other — level is only one block. 👉 Tick a row to open his card.
s.— même club, division et poste : intégr: — same club, division and position: included in both charts of this card
s.— même poste, autre club et/ou champion: — same position, other club and/or league: included in the Trend curve
s.✓ = même club, même division, même poste: ✓ = same club, same division, same position: added in grey to the Trend and Opponents charts
s.📈 = même poste mais autre club et/ou cha: 📈 = same position but other club and/or league: added in orange to the Trend curve only
s.Buts marqués sur la saison, toutes compé: Goals scored over the season, all competitions of this league. Indicative data: it enters no score.
s.Passes décisives sur la saison. Indicati: Assists over the season. Indicative: outside the score. Creation is measured by the Creation pillar (xA, actions created).
s.Impect ne donne pas de date de fin pour: Impect gives no end date for this player. He drops out of the “Contract ends between” filter, unless “Also keep players with no date” is ticked.
s.Date de fin de contrat selon Impect. Une: Contract end date according to Impect. A passed date means the Impect record is out of date or the player is a free agent: to be checked.
s.Il ne sera plus proposé dans les recherc: He will no longer be suggested in position searches.
s.Les joueurs du même poste qui lui ressem: Players at the same position who resemble him most: pillars, RCSC profiles, level, league, play under pressure.
s.Piliers — survol : poids dans le score: Pillars — hover: weight in the score
s.Ce poste ne correspond qu'à un seul arch: This position matches only one archetype.
s.Saisons où il a assez joué pour être éva: Seasons in which he played enough to be assessed at this archetype. Buttons “📅 His other seasons” at the top of the card open them. “✓ in both charts” = same position, club and division; “📈 Trend curve” = same position, other club and/or league.
s.Une seule saison évaluée à ce poste pour: Only one season assessed at this position for this player.
s.Même formule que le Score de saison : pe: Same formula as the season Score: performance over the period + club level + age. Rank among all players at the position active over the period.
s.Performance retenue pour le classement,: Performance retained for the ranking, after the small-sample safeguards. Compared with his season performance (card).
s.La même période sans les garde-fous du m: The same period without the monitoring safeguards (season confidence, no corrected metric): what the player showed, noise included.
s.Part du signal conservée pour chaque mét: Share of the signal kept for each metric: 30% under one full match, 60% at 400 minutes (the season minimum), 100% at 15 matches. The more he has played, the less his performance is pulled towards 50.
s.Métriques hors de la plage de confiance,: Metrics outside the confidence range, brought back to its bound (never excluded). The range is narrower the less he has played.
s.Aucun match détaillé à ce poste sur la p: No detailed match at this position over the period.
s.Métriques ramenées dans la plage de conf: Metrics brought back into the confidence range:
s.Pas encore de fiche de saison : il faut: No season card yet: 400 minutes played at this position over a season are needed to be assessed by the season scoring.

s.Aucun joueur ne correspond à ces filtres: No player matches these filters over the period.
s.Rang au Score parmi tous les joueurs du: Rank by Score among all players at the position active over the period, before your filters.
Matches played at this position over the period.
s.Performance sur la période + niveau du c: Performance over the period + club level + age: same formula and same scale as the season Score.

s.La même période sans les garde-fous du m: The same period without the monitoring safeguards: what he showed, noise included. Far above the retained performance = big match(es) on little playing time.
s.Part du signal conservée : 30 % sous un: Share of the signal kept: 30% under one full match, 60% at 400 min, 100% at 15 matches.
s.Métriques ramenées dans la plage de conf: Metrics brought back into the confidence range (narrower at low volume).

s.Fin de contrat selon Impect. Vide = non: Contract end according to Impect. Empty = not available.

s.Profil du poste dont la correspondance e: Profile of the position with the highest match. Detail in the card.
s.Ressemblance au profil (0-100) : un styl: Resemblance to the profile (0-100): a style, not a level.
s.Écart de niveau entre ses matchs contre: Level gap between his matches against the top of the league and his other matches, as a position percentile: 75+ = raises his level against the big teams, 25- = drops. Detail in the card.

s.Coefficient adversaire moyen : >1 = cale: Average opponent coefficient: >1 = schedule harder than his club
s.La même mesure sur toutes ses passes, pr: The same measure on all his passes, pressed or not.
s.Part de ses passes sous forte pression q: Share of his passes under high pressure that gain ground towards goal.
s.Cette part rapportée à la même part sans: That share relative to the same share without pressure: 1.00 = he plays the same pressed or free.
s.Adversaires supprimés par ses passes, au: Opponents taken out by his passes, above expected.
s.La base ne contient pas l'étude de press: The database does not contain the pressure study.
s.Chaque valeur est ramenée à ce qu'elle v: Each value is brought to what it would be worth in the JPL, based on the measured effect of league level and pressure. Unticked: raw values.
s.Clique une première date puis une second: Click a first date then a second: only players whose contract ends between the two remain. Empty = no filter.
s.. 👉 Clique sur une ligne pour ouvrir la: . 👉 Click a row to open the player's card.
s.Résister 40 % · Oser 30 % · Peser 30 %,: Resist 40% · Dare 30% · Impact 30%, as position percentiles after adjustment to JPL context. 50 = median player at the position.

s.Part de ses passes faites sous forte pre: Share of his passes made under high pressure.
s.Mêmes filtres que le classement. Cinq pr: Same filters as the ranking. Top five per metric
s.Matchs pairs vs impairs. Au-dessus de 0,: Even vs odd matches. Above 0.60 the measure describes the player.
s.Aucun joueur du RSC Charleroi dans cette: No RSC Charleroi player in this database.

s.À chaque poste, le joueur qui a le plus: At each position, the player who played the most **at that position** over the season. 👉 The button opens his full card.
s.Quel archétype la plateforme applique à: Which archetype the platform applies to each position at the club, and how many players are assessed there.
s.Un joueur ayant tenu deux postes apparaî: A player who held two positions appears on one row per position. 👉 Tick a row to open his card.
s.Navigue d'une liste à l'autre par les on: Move from one list to another with the tabs. The values shown are **recalculated at every build**: a player added last year shows his current level.
s.👉 Coche une ligne pour ouvrir sa fiche,: 👉 Tick one row to open his card, several to compare or move.
s.Évolution réelle estimée entre ses ~10 d: Estimated real change between his last ~10 matches and the rest of the season. Beyond ±3 = notable change.
s.Sélectionne au moins un joueur pour agir: Select at least one player to act on.
s.ex. à revoir contre un bloc bas: e.g. to review against a low block

s.50 = médiane du poste. Piliers classés p: 50 = position median. Pillars ordered by weight in the score.
s.Comparaison limitée à 5 joueurs : réduis: Comparison limited to 5 players: reduce the selection.
s.ne pèse pas devant le but: no threat in front of goal

**2. The context adjustment.** On players present in two seasons of the study at the same position, we measure how much each metric moves when the league changes level (Impect rating) and pressure. A coefficient is applied only if it is clear (|t| ≥ {0}); otherwise the metric is not adjusted. Each value is then brought to what it would be worth in the {1}, at the same position.

Un joueur d'un championnat plus fort que la JPL est donc relevé, un joueur d'un championnat plus faible abaissé.

**3. Le score de pression** : percentile du poste sur chaque métrique ajustée, puis **Résister 40 %** (réussite sous pression 30, réussite toutes passes 10), **Oser 30 %** (part de passes progressives sous pression 20, maintien de l'ambition 10), **Peser 30 %** (adversaires éliminés vs attendu 20, entrées dans la surface 5, volume par 90 : 5). **3. The pressure score**: position percentile on each adjusted metric, then **Resist 40%** (success under pressure 30, success all passes 10), **Dare 30%** (share of progressive passes under pressure 20, ambition retained 10), **Impact 30%** (opponents bypassed vs expected 20, box entries 5, volume per 90: 5).
